description: Mark an individual alert firing (event) as handled / acknowledged. Unlike silence_alert (which temporarily mutes the whole alert rule), ack is a per-event receipt — future firings of the same rule are still delivered as usual. Pass the id obtained from list_alert_events as eventId. Re-acking an already acknowledged event does not overwrite the existing ack info (the first acknowledgedAt / acknowledgedBy) and returns 200 (idempotent; distinguishable via the alreadyAcknowledged flag).
name: acknowledge_alert
